# redo_ensembles_claude.txt
# Blackboard / master manifest of the REDO production ensembles (corrected-gsq, bug-fixed) on AFFINE.
# CANONICAL location: /project/qed3/qed3/src/production/ (git-synced). RUN DATA in /lustre2/affine/redo/.
# Generated by the _fermilab block driver (Hasenbusch, Nf-packed, split-pole D/Df, frozen Zolotarev window).
# See params_L1L2_claude.md / params_massive_claude.md and cost doc redo_cost_estimate_claude.md.
# 26 at=0.2 streams (18 massless Nf{2,4,6} + 8 massive Nf2) + 6 HALF-a_t massless (at=0.1, Nt=128, L1 g1.0 & L2 g2.0, Nf{2,4,6})
#   + 9 L=3 (at=0.2) massless (gsq{1.5,3,4.5} x Nf{2,4,6}, KMAX 800, slots p19-p23; ADDED 2026-07-28).
#
# UPDATE 2026-07-23:
#   - at=0.2 MASSLESS stats BUMPED: -DKMAX L1 2000->4000 and L2 1200->4000 (KRNG 5->20).
#   - HALF-a_t (at=0.1) ensembles ADDED: slots p16/p17/p18, -DKMAX 2000, -DAT_VAL=0.1 binaries (_at0p1).
#   - Default QOS flipped opp->normal (affine.lq2_gpu now allocation-backed; small ~2 kcore-hr -> QOS=opp for bulk when it drains).
#
# UPDATE 2026-07-25 (MEASUREMENT -- extended-statistics conn+disc, LAUNCHED):
#   - `run_conn_disc_ext_claude.sh` LAUNCHED (combined single script, SEQUENTIAL: PHASE1 conn MPS 2/GPU
#     4 workers -> PHASE2 disc no-MPS 1/GPU 2 workers; MPS daemon quit between phases if script started it).
#   - STRIDE=10 (2x the old stride-20 grid), nhits1, disc tb2, kmin=first (k>=20 therm cut in analysis).
#   - COVERS ALL 33 massless ens: at0.2 L1/L2/L4 (9+9+9) + at0.1 half-at L1/L2 (3+3). RESUMABLE (per-config
#     h5 complete-gate; old stride-20 configs are a subset of the stride-10 grid -> skipped, no rework).
#   - ETA ~200h (~8.3d) both GPUs: conn ~110h + disc ~88h (at0.2). Per-config wall (measured): conn
#     136/318/1603 s (L1/L2/L4, MPS 2/GPU), disc 66/124/467 s (1/GPU).
#   - Concurrency note: MPS is PER-GPU so conn(MPS)+disc(noMPS) cannot share a GPU; true concurrency
#     (1 GPU/channel) makes conn the bottleneck (~220h) SLOWER than 2-phase-on-both-GPUs -> chose sequential.
#   - Standalone `run_conn_ext_claude.sh` / `run_disc_ext_claude.sh` (stride 10) also available.
#   - Earlier (kmax=2000, stride 20) conn/disc + condensate + glue-shapes sweeps already DONE; this run
#     extends the fermion tower to the full stride-10 grid. loc_ncfg/obs columns below still 0 -> fill after.

# # status column:  DONE = target reached = CLOSED (its wrapper slot is commented out in run_wrapper_redo_claude.sh;
# #                 re-apply no longer submits it).   running = still filling.

# #   still write here (affine Lustre, compute charged qed3). MIGRATION RULE: to move a slot between accounts,
# #   cancel the WHOLE old-account chain (running+pending, PER-SLOT single -n) then the pre-submitted new-account
# #   chain (anchored on the old tail) runs alone -- NEVER cancel only old-pending while old-running (double-writer).
# #   L3 Nf4/6 nsteps bumped {3,3,3}->{4,4,4} (Nf2 stays 3). Job names now pretty: p<idx>_[a1]L<l>N<n>g<gsq*10>[m..].

# ----- RSYNC (SCC -> local): pull the L4 gauge configs for local analysis --------------------------
# SCC host : scc1.bu.edu  (or scc2.bu.edu; /projectnb is shared across SCC login + compute nodes)
# SCC base : /projectnb/qfe/nmatsum/qed3/src/production/     (each ensemble = <col-1 basename>/ under here)
# Pull ONLY ckpoint_lat.* -- the gauge configs (ckpoint_lat.<k>, k=1..ncfg, ~0.64 MB each). Do NOT pull
# ckpoint_rng.* (thinned, ~0.5 GB each, not needed for measurement), logs, or binaries.
# From the LOCAL machine (repeatable; rsync sends only new k's):
#   rsync -avz --prune-empty-dirs \
#     --include='Nf*_*L4_hb*/' --include='ckpoint_lat.*' --exclude='*' \
#     nmatsum@scc1.bu.edu:/projectnb/qfe/nmatsum/qed3/src/production/ <LOCAL_DEST>/
# (or per-ensemble: rsync -avz nmatsum@scc1.bu.edu:'<SCC base><basename>/ckpoint_lat.*' <LOCAL_DEST>/<basename>/)

# ==================================================================================================
# L4 Nf4,6 -- MASSLESS ONLY. STARTED at FNAL (affine) 2026-07-17, then HANDED OFF TO SCC 2026-07-22 (NM).
# FNAL generated to k~47-52 then STOPPED; SCC rsync'd the configs (all ckpoint_lat.* + latest ckpoint_rng)
# from lq.fnal.gov:/lustre2/affine/redo/ via tmp_rsync_fnal_L4_claude.sh (kinit; rsync -avz, no -c) into the
# matching SCC dirs, and RESUMES generation to KMAX=400 on SCC. Clean handoff (no double-writer).

# -DLREF=4 -DKMAX=400 -DKRNG=4 -DMIXED_FORCE -DL4_MDSTEP=5 (steps {5,5,5}; Nf2 L4 = {4,4,4}). Same physics
# params as FNAL: ladder {0,0.4,1.0}, tau 1.0, gauge MG100, frozen Zolotarev (0.008,5), n_action31/n_force11.
# SCC launcher = run_all_L4_scc_claude.sh (UNIFIED driver: per-ensemble GPU pin; re-run to chain further).
# **FP64 pin (2026-07-22): this HMC is double-precision, so jobs are pinned OFF weak-FP64 L40S/A40 onto
# strong-FP64 GPUs via -l gpu_type. FINAL: ALL streams -> V100 (qfe has ece buy-in priority on V100 +
# 26-node public pool; A100/H200 free GPUs are other groups' locked buy-in -> those jobs sat in qw).**

# ----- RSYNC (FNAL -> local): pull the L1/L2/L4 gauge configs for local analysis -------------------
# FNAL host : lq.fnal.gov   (login node; needs your FNAL ssh/kerberos auth. ~/affine -> /lustre2/affine symlink)
# FNAL base : /lustre2/affine/redo/     (each ensemble = <col-1 basename>/ under here; covers L1/L2 + L4)
# Pull ONLY ckpoint_lat.* -- the gauge configs (ckpoint_lat.<k>, ~0.64 MB each). Do NOT pull ckpoint_rng.*
# (thinned KRNG, ~0.5 GB each, not needed for measurement), logs, binaries (*.o), or slurm_*.out.
# From the LOCAL machine (repeatable; rsync sends only new k's) -- all redo L1/L2/L4 ensembles at once:
#   rsync -avz --prune-empty-dirs \
#     --include='Nf*_*nt128L*_hb*/' --include='ckpoint_lat.*' --exclude='*' \
#     nmatsum@lq.fnal.gov:/lustre2/affine/redo/ <LOCAL_DEST>/
# (or per-ensemble: rsync -avz nmatsum@lq.fnal.gov:'/lustre2/affine/redo/<basename>/ckpoint_lat.*' <LOCAL_DEST>/<basename>/)
